\]

\[
V^{a_1} H^{a_2} V^{a_3} H^{a_4} V^{a_5}
\]

where each \(a_i \ge 1\) and the sum of the H-block lengths = 8, sum of V-block lengths = 8.

\(a_2 + a_4 = 8\) (V's)
